description: Buy a coin on one exchange, withdraw it on a network both exchanges share (same chain and contract, never matched by ticker), sell on another: real-transfer net after taker fees, order-book slippage and the withdrawal fee at your size, pre-funded net, capacity at net >= 0 / 0.3% / 1%, arrival estimate, hedge cost on a perp, status and reasons. view=traps lists spreads that exist only because deposits or withdrawals are closed.
name: transfer_routes
title: Cross-exchange transfer (spot) arbitrage routes
